text:
Alex: Heads-up: vendor ratecard ingest for the new pricing experiment mis-mapped ~0.6% of accounts into the lower legacy tier. affects our revenue projection and grandfathering logic.
Priya: Oof. are invoices already touched or just shadow projections?
Alex: Just projections and invoice previews, not final invoices. previews run nightly; final invoices tomorrow morning.
Priya: can you drop a few sample customer ids? i'll run a quick diff.
Alex: samples: C-8921, C-9012, C-9920.
Alex: CSV row from vendor: ```"account_id","rate_tier","legacy_credit"\n"C-8921","tier_standard"," true "```
Alex: Parser output: ```{"account_id":"C-8921","rate_tier":"tier_standard","legacy_credit":true}```
Lena: Parser bug: we trim rate_tier but NOT legacy_credit. the string " true " (with surrounding spaces) becomes truthy after cast. should detect quoted whitespace as empty.
Priya: That would flip customers into grandfathered state unexpectedly. how did vendor send the file? SFTP?
Marta: VendorOps here  we push via SFTP drop at /incoming/ratecards/ and then signal webhook. we'll re-export and sanitize fields.
Ethan: Do we pause the experiment rollout until this is fixed? product needs accurate predictions to approve canary.
Alex: Proposal: pause cohort assignment for new enrollments (no new accounts into cohorts) and keep existing cohorts as-is. also revert preview generation until we patch parser and re-run ingest.
Priya: Agreed. i'll disable nightly preview job (job-id: previews-2024-03-27) immediately.
Lena: I'll push a hotfix to the ingest parser to treat legacy_credit as follows: ```legacy_credit = strip(field).lower() in ["true","1","yes"]``` and add schema validation to reject rows with whitespace-only fields.
Marta: We'll resend corrected CSV in 15m and include a checksum.
billing-bot: Incident created: FIN-2260 - "ratecard ingest: legacy_credit whitespace parse" assigned to Lena, priority P2. https://redwood.example/incidents/FIN-2260
Priya: Next steps for finance: run a reconciliation diff between current projections and corrected projections once backfill completes. need per-account delta and total projected rev change.
Alex: If projected revenue delta > 2% we delay canary; if <0.5% proceed. set thresholds on the ticket.
Ethan: PM approves pause for enrollments and re-run. keep CS on standby for customer outreach if previews had been shared.
Marta: Corrected file uploaded: /incoming/ratecards/ratecard_2024-03-27-fixed.csv, sha256: abcdef...
Lena: Hotfix deployed to staging, running ingest against corrected file now. will trigger backfill to recompute previews.
billing-bot: Backfill queued: job-9001 (recompute previews + projection diffs). ETA 34m.
Priya: I'll prepare a templated support note for affected customers in case previews were emailed: short explanation + reassurance that no invoices issued yet. cc legal if wording needed.
Alex: Also confirm grandfathering flags used for cohort logic: cohort-green: grandfather=false; cohort-blue: grandfather=true. don't swap flags during re-ingest.
Lena: Validation results: initial run shows 0.63% accounts were misflagged; projected revenue swing -0.9% on tiered ARR. detailed CSV attached to FIN-2260.
Alex: Good catch. Priya please attach per-account deltas and close loop with product.
Priya: On it. ETA 2h for full reconciliation and report.
Ethan: Thanks all. once PR is posted on FIN-2260 i'll review and sign off for canary windows. :thumbsup:
